verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no documented in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The 'AI Visual Editor' is an AI tool for building experiment variations, not for analyzing data. The Insights dashboards review experiment impact and metric correlations but are not described as AI-generated. The MCP server brings in external AI tools rather than providing in-product AI insights. All of these are adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
